Name: Font Settings UI - DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface
Author: EtaMyosotis
Description:
[size=3]I didn't find anyone else doing it, so I did.

For use with [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url].

Installed:
1. Download and unzip the file.
2. Place the extracted folder into the Mods folder. The purpose of this step is to replace the original UI inside Font Settings with my files.If your Font Settings is placed in another path, please change the location according to your path.[/size]
